title: Хлопчик під сходами
scene: Звичайний будинок у передмісті. Хлопчик живе в комірчині під сходами, а родина святкує день народження кузена.
scene_pl: Zwyczajny dom na przedmieściach. Chłopiec mieszka w komórce pod schodami, a rodzina świętuje urodziny kuzyna.

tasks.q: Welcome to your first MovieLang lesson! In 10 minutes you will step into the opening scenes of the story.
options: Learn 8 words for family life and feelings
Hear real-speed English and catch key phrases
Master Present Simple vs Present Continuous in context
Say your first lines out loud like the characters
tasks.tip: Start the free lesson

tasks.q: Match the words from the scene with their meanings.
options: cupboard=a small room for storing things
spoiled=given too much, so behaves badly
tasks.tip: These five words describe the world Harry lives in before the magic starts.

tasks.q: The family wants to look perfectly normal. Which word means the same?
tasks.tip: 'Ordinary' = normal, typical. The opposite in this story is 'extraordinary'.

tasks.q: Listen. What is the aunt asking Harry to do?
tasks.tip: 'Get up' and 'cook' are typical morning chores. Notice how fast the order sounds!
tasks.say: Up! Get up now and come and cook the breakfast. And don't burn anything today.

tasks.q: Every morning Harry ____ breakfast for the whole family.
tasks.tip: A routine or habit → Present Simple: he makes. Signal words: every morning, usually, always.

tasks.q: Look! Dudley ____ his birthday presents and he isn't happy.
tasks.tip: 'Look!' shows an action happening right now → Present Continuous: is counting.

tasks.q: Put the words in the right order to describe Harry's life.
tasks.tip: Negative Present Simple: subject + doesn't + base verb.

tasks.q: Type the missing word: Harry sleeps in a small cupboard ____ the stairs.
tasks.tip: Preposition of place: under / beneath the stairs.

tasks.q: Harry's cousin gets fewer presents this year than last year, and he is angry about it.
tasks.tip: He counts them and finds there are fewer than last year, so he complains loudly.
tasks.scene: At breakfast, the cousin counts a big pile of presents.

tasks.q: Repeat the sentence with natural rhythm. Stress the words in CAPITALS: I'm NOT ALLOWED to ask QUESTIONS here.
tasks.say: I'm not allowed to ask questions here.
tasks.tip: 'Not allowed to' = it is forbidden. Great phrase for talking about rules.

title: Пригода в зоопарку
scene: Родина бере хлопчика до зоопарку. Біля скла з великою змією стається щось дивне: скло раптом зникає.
scene_pl: Rodzina zabiera chłopca do zoo. Przy szybie z wielkim wężem dzieje się coś dziwnego: szkło nagle znika.

tasks.q: Match the zoo words.
options: reptile house=building for snakes and lizards
glass=the clear wall of a tank
to hiss=to make a long 'sss' sound
tasks.tip: You need these to retell the zoo scene.

tasks.q: Harry ____ to the snake when the glass suddenly disappeared.
tasks.tip: Longer background action (was talking) interrupted by a short event (disappeared).

tasks.q: While Dudley was pressing his face to the glass, the snake ____ out.
tasks.tip: Short completed event in the past → Past Simple: slid.

tasks.q: Listen. Where is the snake originally from, according to the sign?
tasks.tip: The sign says it was bred in the zoo, but the species comes from Brazil.
tasks.say: This snake was born here at the zoo, but its family originally comes from Brazil.

tasks.q: Past Simple of 'fall': Dudley ____ into the water.
tasks.tip: fall → fell → fallen (irregular).

tasks.q: Harry knew he had magic powers at the zoo.
tasks.tip: He had no idea. He only realised later that strange things happened around him.

tasks.q: Order the words to make a Past Continuous question.
tasks.tip: Question: What + were/was + subject + -ing?

tasks.q: Tell it like a story. Repeat: I was just standing there when the glass disappeared!
tasks.say: I was just standing there when the glass disappeared!
tasks.tip: Past Continuous + when + Past Simple = perfect storytelling pattern.

title: Листи нізвідки
scene: Хлопчику починають приходити листи. Дядько їх знищує, але наступного дня листів стає дедалі більше.
scene_pl: Do chłopca zaczynają przychodzić listy. Wuj je niszczy, ale następnego dnia listów jest coraz więcej.

tasks.q: A letter is closed with red wax. What is the wax called?
tasks.tip: A seal is wax pressed with a symbol. A stamp is what you pay postage with.

tasks.q: Match the verbs.
options: to deliver=to bring post to a place
to tear up=to rip into pieces
to hide=to put where no one can see
to board up=to cover with wooden planks
tasks.tip: Uncle tries everything: he hides, tears up and even boards up the letterbox.

tasks.q: Hundreds of letters ____ through the chimney.
tasks.tip: Passive, past, plural: were + past participle (sent).

tasks.q: The first letter ____ by Uncle Vernon before Harry could read it.
tasks.tip: was + past participle. Take → took → taken.

tasks.q: Make it passive: Someone delivered the letters by owl. → The letters were ____ by owl.
tasks.tip: were + delivered (past participle).

tasks.q: Order the words (passive).
tasks.tip: Subject + was + past participle + with...

tasks.q: Listen. Where is the letter addressed to?
tasks.tip: The address is so exact that it shows someone knows where Harry sleeps.
tasks.say: Mr H. Potter, The Cupboard under the Stairs, Number Four.

tasks.q: The family stayed at home until the letters stopped.
tasks.tip: They ran away to a hotel and then to a tiny house on a rock in the sea.

title: Хранитель ключів
scene: Штормова ніч на острові. Велетень вибиває двері, приносить торт і розповідає хлопчику правду про його батьків.
scene_pl: Burzowa noc na wyspie. Olbrzym wyważa drzwi, przynosi tort i opowiada chłopcu prawdę o jego rodzicach.

tasks.q: A giant knocks on the door at midnight. Today you learn to report what people said.
tasks.tip: Let's go

tasks.q: Hagrid: 'You are a wizard.' → Hagrid told Harry that he ____ a wizard.
tasks.tip: Reported speech: present → past (are → was).

tasks.q: Harry: 'Are you sure?' → Harry asked if Hagrid ____ sure.
tasks.tip: Yes/no questions: asked + if/whether + subject + past verb.

tasks.q: Uncle: 'I won't pay for that school.' → Uncle said that he ____ pay for that school.
tasks.tip: will → would; won't → wouldn't.

tasks.q: Match the reporting verbs.
options: to admit=to agree something is true, unwillingly
to promise=to say you will surely do it
to refuse=to say you won't do it
to warn=to say something bad may happen
tasks.tip: Better than just 'said' — these verbs make your stories vivid.

tasks.q: Order the reported question.
tasks.tip: In reported questions, NO question word order: who + subject + verb.

tasks.q: Listen. What did Hagrid bake for Harry?
tasks.tip: It's a little squashed, but made with love.
tasks.say: I made you a birthday cake. It got a bit squashed on the way, but it should still taste good.

tasks.q: Report it! Repeat: He told me that I had been famous all my life.
tasks.say: He told me that I had been famous all my life.
tasks.tip: Past perfect in reported speech: had been.

title: Чарівна вулиця покупок
grammar: Quantifiers: too / enough / a lot of / few
scene: Велетень веде хлопчика на приховану вулицю з крамницями: банк, мантії, книги, котли.
scene_pl: Olbrzym prowadzi chłopca na ukrytą ulicę ze sklepami: bank, szaty, książki, kociołki.

tasks.q: A magical street full of shops. A place where money is kept safely is a…
tasks.tip: The bank is run by goblins and has very deep vaults.

tasks.q: Shopping list: match.
options: vault=a safe room in a bank
tasks.tip: You will see all of these at the school too.

tasks.q: Harry has never had ____ money to buy what he wants.
tasks.tip: enough + noun = the right amount. 'Too' needs an adjective: too expensive.

tasks.q: The robes were ____ long, so the tailor shortened them.
tasks.tip: too + adjective = more than needed.

tasks.q: Complete: There were so ____ people in the street that Harry got lost for a moment.
tasks.tip: many + countable plural (people).

tasks.q: Harry discovered that his parents had left him nothing.
tasks.tip: There was a vault full of gold coins waiting for him.

tasks.q: Order the words.
tasks.tip: enough + noun + to-infinitive.

tasks.q: Shopping English. Repeat: Excuse me, how much is this? It's a bit too expensive for me.
tasks.say: Excuse me, how much is this? It's a bit too expensive for me.
tasks.tip: A polite, useful phrase for real shops.

title: Паличка обирає чарівника
scene: Старовинна крамниця паличок. Хлопчик пробує кілька, доки одна не обирає його.
scene_pl: Stary sklep z różdżkami. Chłopiec próbuje kilku, aż jedna wybiera jego.

tasks.q: This is the shop ____ every young wizard buys a wand.
tasks.tip: Place → where.

tasks.q: The wand ____ chose Harry has a very special core.
tasks.tip: Thing → which / that.

tasks.q: The old man ____ shop is full of boxes remembers every wand he has sold.
tasks.tip: Possession → whose (his shop → whose shop).

tasks.q: Complete with one word: Harry is the boy ____ survived.
tasks.tip: Person → who / that.

tasks.q: Match the descriptions.
options: brother wand=a wand which shares the same core
tasks.tip: Notice how definitions themselves use relative clauses!

tasks.q: Make one sentence with a relative clause.
tasks.tip: Relative clause in the middle: The owl (which Hagrid bought) is…

tasks.q: The first wand Harry tried was perfect for him.
tasks.tip: Several wands caused chaos before the right one chose him.

tasks.q: Describe like a pro: Repeat: It's the kind of place where you feel the magic in the air.
tasks.say: It's the kind of place where you feel the magic in the air.
tasks.tip: 'The kind of place where…' is a great B2 phrase.

title: Платформа дев'ять і три чверті
grammar: Modals of deduction: must / might / can't
scene: Вокзал у Лондоні. Хлопчик шукає неіснуючу платформу, а потім у поїзді знайомиться з новим другом.
scene_pl: Dworzec w Londynie. Chłopiec szuka nieistniejącego peronu, a potem w pociągu poznaje nowego przyjaciela.

tasks.q: Platform nine and three-quarters doesn't exist… or does it? Today: guessing and deducing.
options: must = I'm almost sure it's true
tasks.tip: Board the train

tasks.q: There's no platform between 9 and 10. It ____ be real!
tasks.tip: Deduction that something is impossible → can't be.

tasks.q: That family is pushing trolleys with owls. They ____ be going to the same school.
tasks.tip: Strong evidence → must be.

tasks.q: Ron isn't sure about the sweets: 'This one ____ taste like earwax. Be careful!'
tasks.tip: Possibility → might.

tasks.q: Complete: The trolley lady sells sweets, so she ____ be very popular with the students. (strong guess)
tasks.tip: must = logical certainty.

tasks.q: Travel vocabulary.
options: platform=where you get on a train
compartment=a small room in a train
tasks.tip: Useful for real trips too!

tasks.q: Listen. What does Ron ask?
tasks.tip: Polite way to ask for a seat.
tasks.say: Excuse me, do you mind? Is anyone sitting there? Everywhere else is full.

tasks.q: Deduce out loud. Repeat: You must be joking! That can't be the right platform.
tasks.say: You must be joking! That can't be the right platform.
tasks.tip: Natural reaction + deduction.

title: Капелюх розподілу
scene: Великий зал зі свічками під стелею. Старий капелюх вирішує, до якого гуртожитку піде кожен учень.
scene_pl: Wielka Sala ze świecami pod sufitem. Stara tiara decyduje, do którego domu trafi każdy uczeń.

tasks.q: Personality adjectives.
tasks.tip: Each school house values different qualities.

tasks.q: If I ____ the Sorting Hat, I would put Harry in the bravest house.
tasks.tip: Second conditional: If + past (were) + would.

tasks.q: If Harry ____ to the hat's first idea, he would join a different house.
tasks.tip: Unreal present/future: If + Past Simple.

tasks.q: Complete: What house would you choose if you ____ (can) choose?
tasks.tip: can → could in second conditional.

tasks.q: Order the conditional sentence.
tasks.tip: would + verb … if + past.

tasks.q: Hermione hopes to be in the house that values courage.
tasks.tip: She has read about the houses and has strong opinions.

tasks.q: The ceiling looks like the night sky. It is…
tasks.tip: Enchanted = under a magic spell.

tasks.q: Your turn. Repeat and then say it about yourself: If I were a student there, I would want to be brave.
tasks.say: If I were a student there, I would want to be brave.
tasks.tip: Change the adjective to describe YOU.

title: Урок зілля
scene: Холодний підвал, суворий учитель. Він ставить хлопчику складні питання на першому ж уроці.
scene_pl: Zimne lochy, surowy nauczyciel. Na pierwszej lekcji zadaje chłopcu trudne pytania.

tasks.q: A teacher who is very strict and unfriendly is…
tasks.tip: Harsh = severe, unkind.

tasks.q: Phrasal verbs from the classroom.
options: to pick on=to treat someone unfairly
to point out=to show or mention
tasks.tip: Phrasal verbs are everywhere in natural English!

tasks.q: Don't worry, just ____ with your potion. You're doing fine.
tasks.tip: carry on = continue.

tasks.q: If you don't know the answer, ____ it ____ in the book.
tasks.tip: Separable phrasal verb: look it up.

tasks.q: Instructions: order the words.
tasks.tip: Imperatives for instructions.

tasks.q: Complete: Why does the teacher always pick ____ Harry?
tasks.tip: pick on someone.

tasks.q: Harry knew all the answers in his first potions lesson.
tasks.tip: He didn't — and Hermione's hand was up the whole time.

tasks.q: Give an instruction. Repeat: First, read the instructions carefully. Then, add the ingredients one by one.
tasks.say: First, read the instructions carefully. Then, add the ingredients one by one.
tasks.tip: Sequencers: first, then, after that, finally.

title: Перший урок польотів
grammar: Obligation: must / have to / mustn't / don't have to
scene: Учні вперше тримають мітли. Один хлопчик падає, а інший забирає його річ і злітає високо в небо.
scene_pl: Uczniowie pierwszy raz trzymają miotły. Jeden chłopiec spada, a drugi zabiera jego rzecz i wzlatuje wysoko.

tasks.q: Students ____ fly while the teacher is away. It's against the rules!
tasks.tip: mustn't = it is forbidden.

tasks.q: You ____ be an expert on your first day. Just try your best.
tasks.tip: don't have to = it's not necessary.

tasks.q: Yesterday, Neville ____ go to the hospital wing after his fall.
tasks.tip: Past obligation → had to (must has no past form).

tasks.q: Complete: Everyone ____ to hold the broom with their right hand. (obligation, present)
tasks.tip: has to = rule/obligation.

tasks.q: Flying words.
options: to hover=to stay in the air in one place
to land=to come back to the ground
a natural=someone born with a talent
tasks.tip: Harry turns out to be a natural!

tasks.q: Harry caught a glass ball after a long dive, and a teacher saw it.
tasks.tip: Instead of punishment, he got a place on the team.

tasks.q: Order the rule.
tasks.tip: must + base verb.

tasks.q: Talk about rules in your life. Repeat: At my school we had to wear a uniform, but we didn't have to stand up.
tasks.say: At my school we had to wear a uniform, but we didn't have to stand up.
tasks.tip: Past obligation vs no obligation.

title: Троль у підземеллі
scene: Свято Гелловіну. У школу пробрався троль, а одна учениця залишилася сама у вбиральні.
scene_pl: Halloween. Do szkoły dostał się troll, a jedna uczennica została sama w łazience.

tasks.q: Halloween night — and something huge is in the castle. Today: the tense of 'what had already happened'.
options: Tell a dramatic story in English
tasks.tip: Enter the castle

tasks.q: When the boys arrived, the troll ____ already ____ into the bathroom.
tasks.tip: The earlier action → had gone.

tasks.q: Hermione was crying because Ron ____ something unkind earlier that day.
tasks.tip: Earlier past → Past Perfect: had said.

tasks.q: Complete: By the time the teachers came, the boys ____ already defeated the troll. (have)
tasks.tip: had + defeated.

tasks.q: Halloween vocabulary.
tasks.tip: Useful for retelling the scene.

tasks.q: Order the sentence.
tasks.tip: after + Past Perfect.

tasks.q: After that night, Hermione became friends with Harry and Ron.
tasks.tip: Facing danger together changed everything.

tasks.q: Dramatic storytelling. Repeat: I had never seen anything so big in my whole life!
tasks.say: I had never seen anything so big in my whole life!
tasks.tip: had never + past participle = strong emotion.

title: Перший матч
scene: Стадіон, обручі на високих стовпах, глядачі на трибунах. Хлопчик грає свій перший матч у ролі ловця.
scene_pl: Stadion, obręcze na wysokich słupach, kibice na trybunach. Chłopiec gra swój pierwszy mecz jako szukający.

tasks.q: Harry is the ____ Seeker the team has had in a century.
tasks.tip: One-syllable adjective → -est.

tasks.q: The golden ball moves ____ than any other ball.
tasks.tip: Comparative + than.

tasks.q: His broom started to shake ____ during the match.
tasks.tip: Adverb describes HOW it shook.

tasks.q: Complete: This was the ____ (exciting) match of the season.
tasks.tip: Long adjective → the most + adj.

tasks.q: Sports vocabulary.
options: referee=the person who controls the game
tasks.tip: Works for football too!

tasks.q: Harry caught the golden ball with his hands.
tasks.tip: He almost swallowed it — and it still counted!

tasks.q: Order the sentence.
tasks.tip: the best = superlative of good.

tasks.q: Commentate! Repeat: He's flying faster and faster — what an incredible catch!
tasks.say: He's flying faster and faster — what an incredible catch!
tasks.tip: faster and faster = increasing speed.

title: Дзеркало бажань
scene: Порожній клас уночі. Хлопчик знаходить дзеркало, яке показує не відображення, а найглибше бажання.
scene_pl: Pusta sala w nocy. Chłopiec znajduje lustro, które pokazuje nie odbicie, lecz najgłębsze pragnienie.

tasks.q: Harry wishes he ____ his parents.
tasks.tip: Wish about the present → past simple.

tasks.q: Ron wishes he ____ more successful than his brothers.
tasks.tip: wish + were (formal, correct for all persons).

tasks.q: If only I ____ that mirror! Now I can't stop thinking about it. (regret about the past)
tasks.tip: Regret about the past → If only + Past Perfect.

tasks.q: Complete: I wish it ____ (be) Christmas every day.
tasks.tip: were is more formal; was is common in speech.

tasks.q: Feelings.
tasks.tip: Emotions make your English richer.

tasks.q: The headmaster advises Harry to keep visiting the mirror every night.
tasks.tip: He warns that living in dreams means forgetting to live.

tasks.q: Order the advice from the headmaster (in our words).
tasks.tip: The idea of the scene: don't get lost in dreams.

tasks.q: Make a wish. Repeat, then make your own: I wish I could speak English as fluently as a native speaker.
tasks.say: I wish I could speak English as fluently as a native speaker.
tasks.tip: wish + could = ability you'd like to have.

title: Заборонений ліс
scene: Покарання вночі в темному лісі. Хлопчики бачать щось страшне, і їх рятує кентавр.
scene_pl: Kara w nocy w ciemnym lesie. Chłopcy widzą coś strasznego, a ratuje ich centaur.

tasks.q: A night in the Forbidden Forest. Today: imagining how the past could have been different.
options: Third conditional: If + had done, would have done
Talk about regrets and lucky escapes
tasks.tip: Into the forest

tasks.q: If they ____ out after midnight, they wouldn't have got a detention.
tasks.tip: If + Past Perfect…

tasks.q: If the centaur hadn't arrived, something terrible ____.
tasks.tip: …would have + past participle.

tasks.q: Complete: If Harry had stayed in bed, he ____ have seen the hooded figure.
tasks.tip: wouldn't have seen.

tasks.q: Forest vocabulary.
options: to creep=to move slowly and quietly
tasks.tip: Atmosphere words for scary stories.

tasks.q: Order the third conditional.
tasks.tip: would have + pp … if + had + pp.

tasks.q: The boys were in the forest as a punishment.
tasks.tip: It was their detention.

tasks.q: Regret and relief. Repeat: If you hadn't come, we would have been in serious trouble.
tasks.say: If you hadn't come, we would have been in serious trouble.
tasks.tip: Very natural way to say thank you after help.

title: Крізь люк
scene: Троє друзів проходять випробування під школою: гігантські шахи, загадка з зіллям і вогонь.
scene_pl: Trójka przyjaciół przechodzi próby pod szkołą: gigantyczne szachy, zagadka z eliksirami i ogień.

tasks.q: Ron has played chess since he was a child, but he ____ a game like this before.
tasks.tip: Life experience up to now → Present Perfect.

tasks.q: Last night, the three friends ____ through the trapdoor.
tasks.tip: Finished time (last night) → Past Simple.

tasks.q: Hermione: 'I ____ the riddle! It's the smallest bottle.'
tasks.tip: Result now, no time given → Present Perfect.

tasks.q: Complete: Have you ever ____ chess? (play)
tasks.tip: Have you ever + past participle = experience question.

tasks.q: Challenge vocabulary.
tasks.tip: Words of the final adventure.

tasks.q: Ron lets himself be taken in the chess game so Harry can go on.
tasks.tip: A real sacrifice for his friend.

tasks.q: Order the sentence.
tasks.tip: Present Perfect + never + superlative feeling.

tasks.q: Your experience. Repeat, then make it true for you: I've been to London, but I've never seen a real castle.
tasks.say: I've been to London, but I've never seen a real castle.
tasks.tip: been to = visited and came back.

title: Фінал: камінь і твоя історія
scene: Остання зустріч біля дзеркала, червоний камінь у кишені і прощальне свято. Ти розповідаєш історію сам.
scene_pl: Ostatnie spotkanie przy lustrze, czerwony kamień w kieszeni i pożegnalna uczta. Opowiadasz historię sam.

tasks.q: The final lesson! Put together everything you learned and tell the story in your own words.
options: Write and record your own retelling
tasks.tip: Begin the finale

tasks.q: Harry looked in the mirror and suddenly felt that the stone ____ into his pocket.
tasks.tip: Earlier past event → had dropped.

tasks.q: While the teacher ____, Harry was thinking about his mother.
tasks.tip: Background action → Past Continuous.

tasks.q: Review: match the grammar to the example.
options: Reported speech=He said he was tired
tasks.tip: Everything you practised in 16 lessons!

tasks.q: Which school house wins the cup at the end?
tasks.tip: Last-minute points for courage and friendship.

tasks.q: Harry goes back to his aunt and uncle for the summer.
tasks.tip: But now he knows who he really is.

tasks.q: Final speaking. Repeat: This story taught me that friendship and courage matter more than anything.
tasks.say: This story taught me that friendship and courage matter more than anything.
tasks.tip: Use this as the last line of your retelling.

tasks.q: FINAL PROJECT: Write your favourite scene from the film (100–150 words). Use at least: 2 Past Perfect forms, 1 conditional, 1 passive, and 5 words from the marathon.
tasks.tip: Saved! Your teacher (or you) can review it in your account. Congratulations on finishing the marathon!
